$description: Helios's high contrast theme: egui-pop's (black surfaces, white text, strong outlines, larger text) and Helios's own tokens.

surround.$description: Helios component token: behind the photo being edited. Black, as the surfaces around it.

background.$description: egui-pop's viewport: around the image, the surround.

backdrop.$description: egui-pop's viewport: under the image until its tiles arrive, the surround too.

state.$description: Helios component tokens: the state of a node in the graph.

stale.$description: A node whose content is out of date.

pending.$description: A decision waiting for an answer.

overlay.$description: Helios component tokens: a mask shown over the image (the mask display's overlay).

color.$description: Laid over the image where the mask applies, by the mask's value.

opacity.$description: How much of the colour where the mask is full (0 to 1).

desaturate.$description: How far the image under the overlay turns grey (0 its colours, 1 grey, as darktable shows it), so the colour reads on any photo.

danger.$description: Helios component tokens: the primary button of a destructive dialog.
